checks.question: During attrition, how does an office roll resolve, what extra modifier does the Chairman have, and where do a retiring member, card and fatigue go?

clause_checks.requested_clause: how does an office roll resolve
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Modified 1–2: nothing; 3–4: add fatigue; 5+: retire.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: what extra modifier does the Chairman have
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Add one per fatigue on that card; Chairman also adds one.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: where do a retiring member, card and fatigue go
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Move retiree to Pensioners, flip card into Vacant Offices, return its fatigue to supply.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: Who may select London Season cards, in what order and with which tiebreakers? What happens to the display and unused pensioners afterward?

clause_checks.requested_clause: Who may select London Season cards
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Players who completed at least one pensioner retirement or an eligible firm special retirement during this London Season must each take or discard one display card.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: in what order and with which tiebreakers
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: in descending actual total retirement spending. Ties: most total windows, including new prizes, then clockwise from PM.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: What happens to the display and unused pensioners afterward
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Finish the display step by discarding all remaining cards and refilling exactly three: prestige faceup, blackmail facedown, even if nobody took a card. Return all remaining Pensioners to their supplies.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: How do the opportunity marker and extra-action laws affect family actions? If four offices are vacant and the marker already sits on Enlist Writer, how many writers can be placed?

clause_checks.requested_clause: How do the opportunity marker and extra-action laws affect family actions
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Choose a main family action: take it once, or may take it twice if the marker already matched it. Place/move the opportunity marker onto your chosen main action. After the main action, only the latest passed extra-action law may grant its extra action. This extra action is never doubled by the marker and never moves the marker.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: If four offices are vacant and the marker already sits on Enlist Writer, how many writers can be placed
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: With at least four vacant offices, place one additional writer once this turn, so a doubled Writer action can place three total.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: After Seek Share actions, how are new Company shares created and remaining applicants moved? Where was the initial purchase money paid?

clause_checks.requested_clause: how are new Company shares created
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: After all family actions, if Debt and applicants remain, move the rightmost applicant into Court and lower Debt by one. Repeat while both remain. Pieces in Court are Company shares.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: remaining applicants moved
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: With no Debt, slide remaining applicants as far right as possible, preserving order.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: Where was the initial purchase money paid
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Place a member on an empty Stock Exchange space and pay bank: the five queue spaces are £2, £3, £3, £4, £5 (two distinct £3 spaces). It is an applicant, not yet a share. Seeking a share never pays family cash into Company treasuries.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: When hiring, how are vacancies ordered, what consent does hiring your own family require, what happens to promoted fatigue, and what if no candidate or hirer exists?

clause_checks.requested_clause: how are vacancies ordered
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Fill vacant offices in ascending number on their card backs.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: what consent does hiring your own family require
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Own-family hiring needs verbal consent from every other player in that office’s candidate pool, EXCEPT that a Chairman election never requires Nepotism consent. Commander appointments are also exempt.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: what happens to promoted fatigue
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: When promoting an officeholder, transfer its fatigue to the new card and insert its old card, vacant, into ascending hiring order.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: what if no candidate or hirer exists
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: If no candidate exists, or the hirer is vacant, skip the office; it stays vacant and takes no actions, including hiring.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: How is a Chairman elected, how does a deadlocked election resolve, and does the elected Chairman piece remain a tradable Company share?

clause_checks.requested_clause: How is a Chairman elected
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Former Chairman first announces the number of shares needed for a pure majority (more than half of current shares). Any shareholder may campaign; first candidate supported by players controlling that many shares wins.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: how does a deadlocked election resolve
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: If no candidate gets support, former Chairman picks any shareholder including self; no Nepotism consent.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: does the elected Chairman piece remain a tradable Company share
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: It still counts as a share for dividends, majority and scoring, but cannot be traded or invested in firms.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: Explain success-check results, payment, retries, catastrophic destinations and the restriction against dead actions.

clause_checks.requested_clause: success-check results
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Use lowest die: 1–2 success; 3–4 failure, retry if resources and office-specific limits allow; 5–6 catastrophic failure, no more office actions, return officeholder to supply, discard fatigue and flip card into Vacant Offices.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: payment
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: all cash for a Company-office check comes from that acting office’s treasury and is paid to the bank.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: restriction against dead actions
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: You cannot take a dead action with no effect or chance of success: for example trade with no ship or deploy without dice to trigger possible officer losses.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: What are the Chairman’s voluntary borrowing and allocation duties, including consent and track limits?

clause_checks.requested_clause: voluntary borrowing
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: May add up to three Debt freely, each +£5 Balance. Each additional advance requires consent of players controlling majority Company shares (Chairman counts); never pass Debt track end.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: allocation duties
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Then allocate all Balance to other offices’ treasuries, lowering Balance by each transfer. May interleave borrowing and allocation while respecting total borrowing rules.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: What must Shipping do with its budget? State ship costs, destinations, consent requirements and the prerequisite for buying Company ships.

clause_checks.requested_clause: What must Shipping do with its budget
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Must spend treasury until £2 or less remains.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: ship costs, destinations, consent requirements and the prerequisite for buying Company ships
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Lease extra ship £2; fit ship from shipyard £3 without owner consent; buy Company ship £5 only if no ships remain on shipyards. Pay these acquisition fees from Shipping’s treasury to the bank. Place each acquired ship in any sea zone, including China once office exists.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: For a President’s Trade action, explain declared regions, dice penalty, routes and capacity, insufficient writers, protected home regions, bonuses and successful-trade limit.

clause_checks.requested_clause: declared regions and dice penalty
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Declare regions for Trade: include home region, and only regions reachable through open orders with available ship capacity. Each £1 President’s treasury buys one die; subtract one per declared nonhome region.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: successful-trade limit
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: At most one successful Trade per President per turn.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: routes and capacity
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Successful Trade capacity is one order per ship in this Presidency’s sea zone. Trade does not exhaust ships.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: insufficient writers
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: First writer goes to home port. Every later order must extend the connected route filled during this same Presidency’s Trade. Writers from another Presidency cannot extend this route, even when adjacent. Writers do not limit capacity: use all available writers, then continue filling with filled-order tokens for the remaining ships.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: protected home regions
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: No President may fill another President’s home region, even if its office vacant.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: bonuses
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: President earns bank £1 per order; writer owners earn £1 per writer placed.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: What can a Commander target with Deploy, what produces dice and penalties, and when and how are officer losses checked?

clause_checks.requested_clause: What can a Commander target with Deploy
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Target own Presidency’s home, any associated region, or any region bordering an associated region. Cannot target another home region or another Presidency’s Company-controlled region. Company region must have unrest or a closed order to give action an effect.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: what produces dice and penalties
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Exhaust chosen officers/regiments to bottom for one die each and local alliances for printed dice. Subtract the combined strength of target and all other regions in its empire, counting target only once. Company-controlled defense strength is zero.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: when and how are officer losses checked
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: After each attempt, owners roll one die per officer exhausted in attempt; each 6 returns an officer to supply. Regiments never roll officer losses.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: On successful Deploy how are loot and trophies calculated and control imposed? What changes if Deploy catastrophically fails?

clause_checks.requested_clause: On successful Deploy how are loot and trophies calculated
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: On success, take loot from the bank: £4 per target tower + faceup loot modifier, with a minimum of (surviving officers used in this attempt + 1). The Commander also receives one trophy per target tower.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: control imposed
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: After loot and trophies, impose successful control in this order: Remove target tower and dome. If target was an empire capital, remove every matching empire flag throughout India. Open all target orders and remove all its unrest.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: What changes if Deploy catastrophically fails
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: On catastrophe, Commander returns half own family’s trophies rounded up and Commander member to supply. Exhausted officers still check losses.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: How does Governor Administer work across repeated attempts, including bonuses, tax unrest and stopping?

clause_checks.requested_clause: Governor Administer work across repeated attempts
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Each attempt rolls the current pool without penalty, then reduces the pool by one regardless of result. Repeat using the shrinking pool until choosing to stop, no dice remaining, or catastrophe.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: including bonuses
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Success: Take £1, or £2 if the immediately preceding roll was unsuccessful.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: tax unrest
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Tax: Add an unsplit £2 to Company Balance or the Governor’s President’s treasury. Each Tax after the first this turn adds regional unrest.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: stopping
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Repeat using the shrinking pool until choosing to stop, no dice remaining, or catastrophe.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: If Company revenue cannot cover expenses, how do emergency loans work at and below max Debt, how does Standing change, and when are expectations and dividends checked?

clause_checks.requested_clause: how do emergency loans work at and below max Debt
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: If insufficient, take £5 emergency loans. Each loan advances Debt one only while a track space remains. At maximum Debt, keep taking loans without advancing Debt any further.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: how does Standing change
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: One or two loans lower Standing one; three or more lower Standing two. If remaining Balance is lower than expectations under current Standing, lower Standing one. If dividends paid strictly exceed expectations, advance Standing one space.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: when are expectations and dividends checked
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Compare remaining Balance to the expectations under current Standing; if lower, lower Standing one. Dividends follow; if total cash paid as dividends is strictly greater than expectations, advance Standing one space.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: When Company regions face a Crisis, which regions are attacked, in what order and at what strength? How is defense mounted and what happens on successful defense?

clause_checks.requested_clause: which regions are attacked, in what order and at what strength
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: An Invasion or Rebellion against a Company region also triggers secondary Rebellions in every other Company region with unrest. Resolve attacks in this order: primary Crisis first, then secondary regions in Bombay → Madras → Bengal Army order. Primary normal Crisis: normal Invasion/Rebellion attack strength plus unrest in its target region. Every secondary Rebellion: only the number of unrest cubes in that secondary region; no event modifier or empire strength.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: How is defense mounted
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: The associated Commander chooses and exhausts pieces; if vacant Military Affairs itself acts in the Commander’s stead; if both vacant the Chairman chooses. The acting player exhausts active Army pieces to reach at least Crisis strength, or as many as possible. Local alliances provide printed strength usable once; their strength cannot be split.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: what happens on successful defense
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: EQUAL TO OR GREATER THAN Crisis strength: The attack FAILS; defense SUCCEEDS. Remove all unrest in the attacked region. The actual Commander gains one trophy; Military Affairs/Chairman substitutes gain OR lose NO trophies. If this defeated a normal primary Invasion, also remove one attacker tower if possible.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: What happens when a law fails versus passes, including support-zero, policy movement, Prime Minister and effect order?

clause_checks.requested_clause: What happens when a law fails versus passes
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: −1 or less fails: discard law, resolve dilemma’s If Failed text, Opposition Leader returns token and takes PM dial; new PM moves proposed policy one space either direction and resolves that adjacent policy. Zero or higher passes: place law with passed laws, PM takes passed-law token, resolve selected policy then immediate law effects.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: including support-zero
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Zero or higher passes.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: policy movement, Prime Minister and effect order
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: new PM moves proposed policy one space either direction and resolves that adjacent policy. On pass resolve selected policy then immediate law effects. Finally restore every card used for voting to its regular orientation.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: When can or must a Deregulation session be called in the relevant scenarios, and what are its success/failure effects and exceptions from ordinary voting?

clause_checks.requested_clause: When can or must a Deregulation session be called
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: In 1758/Long 1710, at turn start before London Season, PM may call special Deregulation vote if Standing and/or Debt on lined space, and must if either on starred space.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: what are its success/failure effects
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Pass lowers Debt one per two current Debt; set Standing to S; PM takes passed-law token; activate firms. Fail increases Company-share scoring value up to a maximum of ±3 VP per share; PM stays in power and law is not discarded.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: exceptions from ordinary voting
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Use ordinary voting procedure and support threshold. No policy accompanies this vote, and PM may vote against it.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: How can a firm be formed or invested in, where does money come from, and what restrictions apply to Company shares, invested workshops and the ten-share limit?

clause_checks.requested_clause: How can a firm be formed or invested in
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Form a firm only if you currently manage none; return eligible Company share or flip workshop, then take £5 from bank to London. Invest with manager consent using same contribution and £5 bank to London.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: where does money come from
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: take £5 from bank into London treasury. Investment cash comes from the bank.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: what restrictions apply to Company shares, invested workshops and the ten-share limit
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Cannot use Chairman share; cannot use Company shares when Standing and/or Debt on lined space; cannot use shares created this turn. Up to ten firm shares; further investments still contribute £5 but create no shares. Invested workshops never return to uninvested.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: Explain firm trading strategy, when checks and order filling occur, initiative, capacity, repeat-filled revenue and firm value growth.

clause_checks.requested_clause: firm trading strategy, when checks and order filling occur
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Managers select strategies simultaneously and secretly. At beginning of associated Presidency operations, matching firms reveal strategy and roll one die per committed £1, paying bid to bank. Fill orders lowest initiative first.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: initiative
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Firm initiative = ship count minus number of successful dice (1s/2s); can be negative.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: capacity
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Fill only OPEN orders, as many as possible up to ships + 1.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: repeat-filled revenue
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: A previously filled order pays half listed revenue, rounded down, not repeated full value.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: firm value growth
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Advance firm Value one space per full £6 added to India treasury this turn.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: How are firm expenses and dividends funded and calculated, and what happens to a failing firm, its shares and workshops?

clause_checks.requested_clause: How are firm expenses and dividends funded and calculated
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Pay £1 per charter ship plus higher of share count or firm value; can use either/both treasuries. Dividends from India treasury only; each dividend pays £1 per firm share plus £1 manager.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: what happens to a failing firm, its shares and workshops
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: If unable to pay, dissolve unless rescued. Shares to Debtor’s Prison (each -1 VP), ships back to shipyards, charter back to family side; workshops remain invested.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: Which components and tracks are unlimited, what happens when a limited supply runs out, and what information is normally hidden?

clause_checks.requested_clause: Which components and tracks are unlimited
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Company Balance, VP and Vote tracks are unlimited.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: what happens when a limited supply runs out
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Components are limited: when a supply runs out, complete as much as possible. Cash, trophy/passed-law tokens, dice and regiments may use proxies.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: what information is normally hidden
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: All information, including discards and family cash, is public except facedown blackmail and temporarily concealed firm strategies/bids during selection.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: What can be traded in negotiations and what cannot? How is a transferred share represented, and can blackmail be traded after use?

clause_checks.requested_clause: What can be traded in negotiations and what cannot
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: May trade enterprises, facedown blackmail, family treasury cash, Company/firm shares, promise cards; may not trade officeholders, writers, officers, prizes, spouses, trophies, passed laws, played blackmail, PM dial or Chairman piece.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: How is a transferred share represented
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Return the old owner’s family member and replace it at the share’s location with a member from the receiving family.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: can blackmail be traded after use
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: After use, keep the card faceup in its owner’s area; it cannot be used again or traded.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: Are immediate and future deals binding? What limits govern promise calling, simultaneous unfulfillable calls and repeated activation after a transfer?

clause_checks.requested_clause: Are immediate and future deals binding
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Immediate transfer is binding. Promise of future behavior is nonbinding, except a printed promise card’s guaranteed effect can be called if possible.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: What limits govern promise calling
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Follow card timing/limits; no promise calls during Final Scoring.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: simultaneous unfulfillable calls
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Guarantor chooses which to fulfill.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: repeated activation after a transfer
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: Transferred resources cannot activate twice.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

checks.question: How does setup use extra player cards for five or six players, distribute holdings, award starting luxury points and build the London display?

clause_checks.requested_clause: How does setup use extra player cards for five or six players
clause_checks.supported_fact_or_case_result: add three extra cards for five players or six for six players. Shuffle and deal evenly.
clause_checks.governing_procedure_condition: Reviewed against selected complete source section; see exact quote/span result.

clause_checks.requested_clause: distribute holdings
